passages.text: GENERAL The following MD&A is intended to assist the reader in understanding our financial condition and results of operations, including an evaluation of the amounts and certainty of cash flows from operations and from outside sources, and is provided as a supplement to and should be read in conjunction with the consolidated financial statements and related notes in Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data in this Form 10-K. Discussions of 2023 items and year-to-year comparisons between 2024 and 2023 that are not included in this Form 10-K can be found within MD&A in our 2024 Form 10-K. References to operational variances pertain to period-over-period changes that exclude the impact of foreign exchange rates. Although foreign exchange rate changes are part of our business, they are not within our control and because they can mask positive or negative trends in the business, we believe presenting operational variances excluding these foreign exchange changes provides useful information to evaluate our results. OVERVIEW OF OUR PERFORMANCE, OPERATING ENVIRONMENT, STRATEGY AND OUTLOOK Financial Highlights –– The following is a summary of certain financial performance metrics (in billions, except per share data): 2025 Total Revenues––$62.6 billion 2025 Net Cash Flow from Operations––$11.7 billion A decrease of 2% compared to 2024 A decrease of 8% compared to 2024 2025 Reported Diluted EPS––$1.36 2025 Adjusted Diluted EPS (Non-GAAP)––$3.22** A decrease of 3% compared to 2024 An increase of 4% compared to 2024 ** For additional information regarding Adjusted diluted EPS (which is a non-GAAP financial measure), including reconciliations of certain GAAP Reported to non- GAAP Adjusted information, see the Non-GAAP Financial Measure: Adjusted Income section within MD&A. Our Business and Strategy –– Pfizer Inc. is a research-based, global biopharmaceutical company. We apply science and our global resources to bring therapies to people that extend and significantly improve their lives. See the Item 1. Business ––About Pfizer section. As a science-driven global biopharmaceutical company, we remain focused on advancing our product pipeline, supporting our marketed brands and deploying capital responsibly, with a focus on initiatives that can help contribute to our long-term revenue and future growth. Most of our revenues come from the manufacture and sale of biopharmaceutical products. We believe that our medicines and vaccines provide significant value for healthcare providers and patients, and we continuously evaluate how we can best collaborate with patients, physicians and payors to support and expand patient access to reliable, affordable healthcare around the world. In addition, we continually seek to expand and broaden our product portfolio offerings through prioritized development of our pipeline and business development opportunities targeted at critical unmet patient needs. As a result, our commercial organizational structure and R&D operations are critical to the successful execution of our business strategy. The expected annual rate of return on plan assets for our U.S. plans and international plans is applied to the fair value of plan assets at each year-end and the resulting amount is reflected in our net periodic benefit costs in the following year. Differences between the actual rate of return on plan assets and the expected annual rate of return on plan assets are immediately recognized through earnings upon remeasurement. credit_strengths.text: Operating cash flow of roughly twelve billion dollars comfortably funds capital expenditure near three billion, leaving free cash flow close to nine billion; this internally generated liquidity underpins the group's ability to service debt and absorb modest earnings volatility without external funding.

Interest coverage sits above four times on operating income and EBITDA coverage exceeds six times, both improving year on year; the group therefore retains meaningful headroom over fixed charges even though coverage trails the sector median, reflecting the debt taken on for acquisitions.

key_risks.text: Gross leverage sits near four times and net leverage above three times, both above the sector median and rising year on year; the indicative financial risk profile is Significant, and only a modest EBITDA decline would push leverage toward the next risk band.

Pension assumptions are a concrete disclosed sensitivity: a half-point cut in the expected return on plan assets raises next-year benefit cost, and actual international returns have been volatile, so funding and earnings could be pressured if asset performance disappoints.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Cash flow coverage of debt is below the sector median and weaker than the prior year, with free cash flow to debt also trailing peers; debt reduction therefore depends on sustained operating cash generation rather than balance-sheet liquidity, as cash holdings are modest relative to borrowings.

The debt stack is predominantly long-dated, with only a small current portion, which limits near-term refinancing pressure; however, the group deployed substantial cash into acquisitions, so discretionary spending competes directly with deleveraging and distributions.

overall_credit_view.text: Revenue is broadly flat and operating margin has slipped below the prior year and the sector median, so the credit story rests on stable cash generation rather than growth; the indicative profile is Significant, and we view the trajectory as stable but sensitive to earnings.

Liquidity is adequate rather than strong: the current ratio exceeds one but sits well below the sector median and eased year on year, so working-capital flexibility is limited; deleveraging toward the upgrade threshold is our base case but requires sustained free cash flow.

credit_strengths.text: 經營現金流約一百二十億美元，足以輕鬆覆蓋近三十億美元的資本開支，令自由現金流接近九十億美元；此內部產生的流動性支撐集團償付債務及吸收溫和盈利波動的能力，而無需外部融資。
利息覆蓋率以經營溢利計高於四倍，EBITDA覆蓋率超過六倍，兩者均按年改善；因此即使覆蓋率落後於行業中位數，集團相對於固定費用仍保留有意義的緩衝空間，反映為收購而承擔的債務。

key_risks.text: 總槓桿接近四倍，淨槓桿高於三倍，兩者均高於行業中位數並按年上升；指示性財務風險狀況為顯著，而僅需溫和的EBITDA下降便會將槓桿推向下一風險區間。
退休金假設是一項具體的已披露敏感度：計劃資產預期回報下調半個百分點會推高下一年度福利成本，而實際國際回報一直波動，因此若資產表現令人失望，供款及盈利可能受壓。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 債務的現金流覆蓋率低於行業中位數，且較上一年度轉弱，自由現金流對債務比率亦落後同業；因此減債取決於持續的經營現金產生，而非資產負債表流動性，因現金持有相對借款而言屬溫和。
債務結構以長年期為主，僅有少量即期部分，限制了短期再融資壓力；然而集團將大量現金投放於收購，因此酌情支出直接與去槓桿及分派競爭。

overall_credit_view.text: 收入大致持平，經營利潤率已跌至低於上一年度及行業中位數，因此信用狀況取決於穩定的現金產生而非增長；指示性狀況為顯著，我們認為其軌跡穩定但對盈利敏感。
流動性屬足夠而非強勁：流動比率高於一但遠低於行業中位數，並按年緩和，因此營運資金靈活性有限；去槓桿至升級門檻是我們的基本情境，但需要持續的自由現金流。
